column1: # The source assets of Hunna Wood (docs/adr/0070-the-sample-games-source-assets.md): every file
# that scripts/fetch-assets.sh puts in this directory, games/hunnawood/assets/. Lines are
# separated by tabs. An `asset` line describes one asset as it was published; the `file` lines
#   asset  NAME  SITE  PAGE  AUTHORS  LICENCE  TAKEN
#   file   PATH  SIZE  SHA256  PUBLISHED  MIRROR
# NAME is the asset's name where it was published, PAGE the address of its page there, LICENCE an
# SPDX identifier (only CC0-1.0 is accepted), TAKEN the day it was downloaded. PATH is where the
# file goes, relative to this directory; SIZE is in bytes; PUBLISHED is the address the file was
# downloaded from, and MIRROR the address of its copy on an immutable release of
# github.com/HoneySlatt/SlimeEngine-assets. Under sources/, the files as they were published,
# which the zone's Blender script reads.
